WITH telescope_weather_averages AS (
  SELECT
    t.telescregistry,
    o.weathprofile,
    AVG(s.modindex) AS avg_modulation_index,
    AVG(s.phaseshiftdeg) AS avg_phase_shift
  FROM signals AS s
  JOIN telescopes AS t ON t.telescregistry = s.telescref
  JOIN observatories AS o ON o.observstation = t.observstation
  GROUP BY t.telescregistry, o.weathprofile
),
above_baseline AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    AVG(avg_modulation_index) OVER () AS baseline
  FROM telescope_weather_averages
)
SELECT
  weathprofile,
  AVG(avg_modulation_index) AS avg_modulation_index,
  AVG(avg_phase_shift) AS avg_phase_shift,
  AVG(avg_modulation_index - baseline) AS avg_modulation_index_above_baseline
FROM above_baseline
WHERE avg_modulation_index > baseline
GROUP BY weathprofile;
